title: Authenticated Creator-Owned Sesh Project HTTP API Boundary
purpose: Expose the already-authorized creator-owned Sesh project read, update, and delete operations through a fail-closed HTTP boundary without trusting client-supplied identity or weakening persistence concurrency guarantees.

identityBoundary.principalValidation: DefaultSessionPrincipalResolver rechecks the canonical active Principal record
identityBoundary.creatorResolution: DefaultAuthenticatedSeshCreatorResolver resolves only through the explicit PrincipalId -> SeshCreatorId mapping

authorization.GET: SESH-027 owner read authorization through SESH-028 operation service
authorization.PATCH: SESH-027 owner write authorization through SESH-028 operation service
authorization.DELETE: SESH-027 owner delete authorization through SESH-028 operation service

requestBoundary.PATCHBody: JSON object passed to the canonical SESH-028 mutable update validator

nextSlice.purpose: Define authenticated Sesh project creation and creator-owned project collection/listing semantics without inferring ownership from client input.
